post.description: Ask the assistant about your own portfolio, goals and net worth. The answer streams as server-sent events of these types: token, tool, source, done, error. `tool` shows which tool ran (name and status only), `source` names the data the answer rests on with its as-of time, `token` carries the answer text (the answer is checked before any of it is sent), `done` closes the turn and `error` ends it with a fixed code. Figures come from WealthSphere's tools, never from the model. Limits: 30 questions per user per 24 hours, 20 tool calls per question.
